places.name: Acropolis of Athens
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Acropolis is an ancient citadel featuring iconic structures like the Parthenon and Erechtheion.
places.place_tip: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water for the climb.

places.name: Plaka Neighborhood
places.ai_summary: A historic neighborhood in Athens, known for its narrow streets, neoclassical architecture, and vibrant atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and cafes may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the local shops and enjoy traditional Greek cuisine at the tavernas.

places.name: Temple of Poseidon at Sounion
places.ai_summary: A stunning ancient temple dedicated to Poseidon, located on a cliff overlooking the Aegean Sea.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during sunset for breathtaking views.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the stunning sunset over the sea.

places.name: Acropolis Museum
places.ai_summary: A modern museum dedicated to the archaeological findings of the Acropolis of Athens, featuring interactive exhibits and a glass floor over ancient ruins.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the museum's restaurant with a view of the Acropolis.

places.name: National Archaeological Museum
places.ai_summary: The largest archaeological museum in Greece, housing an extensive collection of artifacts from ancient Greece, including sculptures, pottery, and jewelry.
places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

attribution.title: Athens National Theatre front
attribution.author: Badseed
attribution.description: The National Theatre (Εθνικό θέατρο) in Athens, front entrance (during restauration).

places.name: Temple of Olympian Zeus
places.ai_summary: An ancient temple in Athens, dedicated to Zeus, featuring impressive ruins and a beautiful park.
places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Hadrian's Arch and the National Garden.

attribution.title: Graduation hat
attribution.author: User:markeith caddell the Oyster
attribution.description: A vector image of a mortar board hat.

places.name: Syntagma Square & Hellenic Parliament
places.ai_summary: The central square of Athens, known for the Hellenic Parliament building and the Changing of the Guard ceremony.

opening_hours.notes: The Changing of the Guard ceremony takes place every hour.

places.place_tip: Watch the Changing of the Guard ceremony in front of the Parliament building.

places.name: Changing of the Guard
places.ai_summary: A ceremonial event in which the Evzones, the presidential guard, change duty in front of the Hellenic Parliament.

opening_hours.notes: The ceremony takes place every hour, on the hour.

places.place_tip: Arrive a few minutes early to get a good viewing spot.

places.name: Monastiraki Square & Flea Market
places.ai_summary: A vibrant square in the heart of Athens, known for its bustling flea market, shops, and street food.

opening_hours.notes: Shops and stalls may have varying hours.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food, especially the souvlaki and gyros.

attribution.title: Acropolis of Athens 01361
attribution.author: Glen Larson at en.wikipedia
attribution.description: Parthenon, the former temple on the Acropolis of Athens, Greece.

places.name: Lycabettus Hill
places.ai_summary: A hill in Athens offering panoramic views of the city, especially beautiful at sunset.

opening_hours.notes: The funicular railway operates from 09:00 to 01:00.

places.place_tip: Take the funicular to the top for stunning views.

places.name: Panathenaic Stadium (Kallimarmaro)
places.ai_summary: An ancient stadium in Athens, known for its impressive marble structure and as the site of the first modern Olympic Games.
places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Zappeion Hall and the National Garden.

places.name: Odeon of Herodes Atticus
places.ai_summary: An ancient theater in Athens, still used today for concerts and performances, known for its excellent acoustics.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check the schedule for performances and concerts.

attribution.title: AcropolisatathensSitePlan
attribution.author: Madmedea.
attribution.description: Site plan of the Acropolis, Athens showing major archaeological remains.

places.name: National Garden
places.ai_summary: A large public park in the center of Athens, offering a peaceful escape with walking paths, a pond, and ancient ruins.

opening_hours.notes: The garden is closed at night.

places.place_tip: Visit the Zappeion Hall located within the garden.

places.name: Piraeus Port
places.ai_summary: The main port of Athens, serving as a gateway to the Aegean Islands, with shops, restaurants, and maritime museums.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry schedules vary, check in advance.

places.place_tip: Try the seafood at the local tavernas.

places.name: Delfi Archaeological Site (Day Trip)
places.ai_summary: An important archaeological site in Greece, once considered the center of the world in ancient mythology, featuring the Temple of Apollo and an ancient theater.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit the Delphi Museum to see the artifacts found at the site.

attribution.title: Ancient Delphi - Temple of Apollo (15491188648)
attribution.author: Paul Stephenson from London
attribution.description: Delphi is a fantastic excursion from Athens. Around 3 hours by us, it has a large archaeology site - the Delphi Sanctuary, containing the Temple of Apollo, where  6 Doric Columns have been reinstated

places.name: Temple of Hephaestus
places.ai_summary: An ancient Greek temple dedicated to Hephaestus, the god of fire and craftsmanship, well-preserved and located in the Ancient Agora of Athens.
places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding Ancient Agora site.

places.name: Kerameikos Archaeological Site
places.ai_summary: An ancient cemetery and archaeological site in Athens, offering insight into ancient Greek burial practices and featuring the Sacred Way.
places.place_tip: Visit the Kerameikos Museum located at the site.

places.name: Saronic Gulf Islands (Day Trips: Hydra, Aegina)
places.ai_summary: Beautiful islands located close to Athens, popular for day trips, featuring stunning landscapes, beaches, and traditional villages.

opening_hours.notes: Ferry schedules vary, check in advance.

places.place_tip: Visit Hydra for its car-free streets and Aegina for its pistachios.

places.name: Museum of Cycladic Art
places.ai_summary: A museum in Athens dedicated to the ancient cultures of the Aegean and Cyprus, featuring Cycladic art, sculptures, and artifacts.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Mondays. Last entry one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique Cycladic art replicas.
